categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/util/btcsignals.h`, a core utility primitive for event signaling and callbacks.
categories.rationale: Fixes a resource lifetime defect in `btcsignals` where disconnected callbacks leak until future connections, avoiding shutdown deadlocks. The description explains that deferred callback destruction prevents release of resources like `mp::EventLoopRef`, causing deadlocks during shutdown.
